name: Shinogi Misa
source:
She is a senior member of the track and field club and is beloved by the younger members of the club.
She hopes that Azusa will become more active and take over as head of the club in the future.
She looks cool, but that is just her appearance; inside, she is surprisingly girly.
translation:
